observations: Stainless steel electric kettle with a black plastic handle and lid.
A separate power base with a black cord and a UK-style 3-pin plug is visible.
There is a clear plastic water level window on the side of the kettle.
The lid is shown open in photo 0 and closed in photo 1.
A power switch is located on the top of the handle.
The exterior shows some smudges and signs of use.

claims.evidence: Requires a video of the kettle heating water.
Requires a timed video of the boiling process.

risks.risk: The heating element may be defective or heavily calcified.
risks.proof: Video of the kettle successfully boiling water.

risks.risk: The kettle may leak from the seams or the water window.
risks.proof: Photo of the kettle sitting on a dry surface after boiling.

risks.risk: The automatic shut-off mechanism may fail to trigger.
risks.proof: Video showing the kettle turning off automatically once boiled.

proof_requests: Video of the kettle boiling water and switching off automatically.
Photo of the manufacturer's label on the bottom of the kettle or base.
Clear photo of the interior to check for limescale or rust.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as an electric kettle. It can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional unit until proof of operation is provided.
